title: Cyber — Wednesday, 21 October 2026
lead: PHP released emergency fixes for PHP2Shell, two critical remote code execution bugs in the PHP core. Cloudflare says early attacks have started.

stories.headline: PHP2Shell: emergency patches for two critical PHP core RCE bugs
stories.summary: PHP shipped fixes for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 at about 13:34 UTC on 21 Oct, after details leaked once PHP pre-announced the release on 20 Oct. It affects any PHP that serves web requests (FPM, mod_php, CGI, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed) and is rated CVSS v4 9.2.
stories.action: Update PHP to 8.5.12 / 8.4.27 / 8.3.36 / 8.2.35, then restart FPM/Apache. CISA says patch immediately.

details.label: Who's affected
details.text: PHP 5.4 through 8.5.11. Branches 8.1 and older only get minimal source backports. Krebs expects site outages as hosts take servers offline.

details.label: Status
details.text: Patched. Early attacks per Cloudflare; Huntress had seen none in its customer base as of 10:00 ET. PoC claims are circulating. Not in KEV yet.

details.label: Your stack
details.text: PHP isn't in your listed stack. Check any container images that bundle PHP.

details.label: Chile
details.text: No CSIRT/ANCI alert on PHP2Shell turned up in search.

framing.text: PHP says "ini settings won't save you" and only patching works, while hosts are deploying stopgaps such as blocking multipart requests.
Google's write-up partly promotes Gemini's role in finding the bugs.

stories.headline: Plex2Shell: four Plex Media Server flaws exploited, added to KEV
stories.summary: Honeypot exploitation started 17 Oct, a day after the PoC went public, and dropped an XMRig miner plus residential-proxy malware. CISA added CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655 and CVE-2026-96656 to KEV on 20 Oct.
stories.action: Update Plex Media Server to 1.43.3.10861 or later.

details.label: Status
details.text: Confirmed exploited. The fix, 1.43.3.10861, has been out since 3 Aug.

stories.headline: SiteGuard Server Edition command injection exploited
stories.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-106931, an OS command injection flaw in EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition, to KEV on 20 Oct. The vendor confirmed exploitation.

stories.headline: Siemens Software Center DLL sideloading used in ClickFix attacks
stories.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-110936, an uncontrolled search path flaw in Siemens Software Center, to KEV on 20 Oct. It is being used for DLL sideloading in ClickFix attacks.

stories.headline: PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 exploited by Qilin and INC to bypass MFA
stories.summary: Unit 42 says ransomware operators including Qilin and INC are exploiting CVE-2026-0257 in PAN-OS to bypass MFA (threat brief updated 20 Oct).
stories.action: Patch PAN-OS following Palo Alto's advisory.

stories.headline: eMudhra CA keys could be computed from the public certificates
stories.summary: The private keys of eight emSign intermediates were whole numbers below 256. Chrome and Firefox blocked them on 17 Oct, Apple on 19 Oct and Microsoft on 20 Oct.

details.label: Who's affected
details.text: Anything trusting the system or bundled CA stores (Go, Node, Python, containers).

details.label: Status
details.text: Confirmed. No misuse seen, and no certificate chaining to the TLS intermediates was logged to CT.

details.label: Next
details.text: Chrome drops the emSign ECC G3 root on about 27 Oct.

stories.headline: SafePay ransomware: joint advisory AA26-293A
stories.summary: On 20 Oct the FBI, CISA and UK and German agencies said SafePay has hit at least 600 victims since 2024, including critical infrastructure.

details.label: Status
details.text: Confirmed (government). Mitigations are in the advisory.

stories.headline: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys are backdooring WordPress sites
stories.summary: Attackers breached TeamUpdraft on 17–18 Oct. From 18 Oct, valid signed commands installed 99+ backdoor plugins.
stories.action: Update to 1.26.13 / 2.26.13 (1.26.12 doesn't actually revoke the keys), then delete leftover keys by hand.

stories.headline: Ubuntu 26.04: ca-certificates update removes the emSign root
stories.summary: USN-8944-1/-2 removes the emSign root from ca-certificates. Container images carry their own CA bundles, so they need re-pulling too.
stories.action: Run apt upgrade ca-certificates, then re-pull container images.

stories.headline: Tailscale v1.104.2 fixes TS-2026-013
stories.summary: Tailscale v1.104.2 addresses security bulletin TS-2026-013 and is built with Go 1.27.3. Mesh/WireGuard traffic is not affected.

stories.headline: Node.js October security releases fix a Brotli RCE
stories.summary: Node 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1 fix four high-severity bugs, including a Brotli RCE (CVE-2026-111497) and a TLS hostname-check bypass, plus the eMudhra distrust.

stories.headline: Python: bump certifi in your venvs
stories.summary: certifi 2026.10.19 is the version to have after the eMudhra distrust; each venv and uv project carries its own copy.
stories.action: Bump certifi to 2026.10.19 or later in your venvs/uv projects.

stories.headline: Chrome 156 ships 353 security fixes
stories.summary: Chrome 156 fixes 353 flaws, none reported exploited.
stories.action: Relaunch Chrome on the Mac and the S21 to get Chrome 156.

stories.headline: Hijacked Tor exit relays stole SSH password logins
stories.summary: About 300 Tor exit relays were hijacked to steal SSH password logins.

stories.headline: ANCI's National Cybersecurity Exercise is on 29 Oct
stories.summary: ANCI's National Cybersecurity Exercise takes place on 29 Oct; sign-ups close on 27 Oct.

stories.headline: Data protection law 21.719: the delay bill is still in the Senate
stories.summary: The bill to delay Ley 21.719 to 1 Dec 2027 is still in the Senate. Until it passes, 1 Dec 2026 stands.

stories.headline: Leak sites list Cotesma and LD Constructora
stories.summary: Ransomware leak sites list Cotesma and LD Constructora (Chile). These are claims, not confirmed by the victims.

stories.headline: Lazarus "Operation FlashHole" abused CrossWeb EX in watering-hole attacks
stories.summary: Kaspersky says Lazarus abused South Korea's CrossWeb EX in watering-hole attacks.

stories.headline: A threat actor got past AI safety controls to plan multiple crimes
stories.summary: Unit 42 describes a threat actor who bypassed AI safety controls to plan and carry out several types of cybercrime.

stories.headline: An Ebury-linked actor hijacked about 10% of Tor exit nodes
stories.summary: An Ebury-linked actor hijacked about 10% of Tor exit nodes in early October.

stories.headline: NSA, CISA and NIST publish guidance on malicious AI agents
stories.summary: NSA, CISA and NIST published joint guidance on detecting and disabling malicious AI agents.

stories.headline: The US bans DeepSeek from government agency systems
stories.summary: The US banned DeepSeek from government agency systems.

gaps: CSIRT Chile and ANCI have no RSS and were checked by search only.
The search backend was flaky (fallbacks used).
Yesterday's edition wasn't available to me, so some stories may repeat.
I haven't checked whether Bun has shipped the eMudhra fix.
